text: The low-disk test must pass the disk gate before the checks and stop only at the gate before the verifier (give it enough free space for the first gate, then less for the second). Keep interrupted process as a resumable cause, as the request says. Say that the retry still runs the reader. Reuse disk::is_environment_reason rather than a near-duplicate. Assert resume by counting planner and producer invocations, not reads of the free-space function.
